info.name: GitHub List Connection Between an External Group and Team

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: team_slug
params.description: The slug of the team name.

items.docs:
Lists a connection between a team and an external group.

You can manage team membership with your identity provider using Enterprise Managed Users for GitHub Enterprise Cloud. For more information, see "[GitHub's products](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/github/getting-started-with-github/githubs-products)" in the GitHub Help documentation.

info.name: GitHub Update the Connection Between an External Group and Team

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: team_slug
params.description: The slug of the team name.

items.docs:
Creates a connection between a team and an external group.  Only one external group can be linked to a team.

You can manage team membership with your identity provider using Enterprise Managed Users for GitHub Enterprise Cloud. For more information, see "[GitHub's products](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/github/getting-started-with-github/githubs-products)" in the GitHub Help documentation.

info.name: GitHub Remove the Connection Between an External Group and Team

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: team_slug
params.description: The slug of the team name.

items.docs:
Deletes a connection between a team and an external group.

You can manage team membership with your IdP using Enterprise Managed Users for GitHub Enterprise Cloud. For more information, see [GitHub's products](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/github/getting-started-with-github/githubs-products) in the GitHub Help documentation.

info.name: GitHub Get Diff of the Dependencies Between Commits

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: basehead
params.description: The base and head Git revisions to compare. The Git revisions will be resolved to commit SHAs. Named revisions will be resolved to their corresponding HEAD commits, and an appropriate merge base will be determined. This parameter expects the format `{base}...{head}`.

params.name: name
params.description: The full path, relative to the repository root, of the dependency manifest file.

items.docs: Gets the diff of the dependency changes between two commits of a repository, based on the changes to the dependency manifests made in those commits.
